claims.text: Previous approaches for style transfer include methods that use pre-trained classifiers, GAN-based approaches with binary classifiers, and structured discriminators such as language models.
Some techniques for style transfer also incorporate back-translation and cycle-consistency loss to enhance the learning of disentangled representations.
The approaches mentioned have fundamentally different assumptions compared to the new neural approach being proposed.
